extraction.NOTES: This document is a cover letter from E. W. Jermark, Superintendent, Pine Ridge, South Dakota, dated September 22, 1928, acknowledging receipt of Circular No. 2464 Fee Patent Data received September 14, 1928. States 333 patents were issued April 13, 1918 and 344 issued September 29, 1919. Notes the reservation extends over an area about 55 miles long and 90 miles wide located in four counties, and that data will be assembled at the earliest possible date as it will necessitate considerable field work. Document reference: 5-1142, No. 112.
